description: INI / .properties to JSON converter — Offline converter for INI and Java .properties files to JSON and back. INI: [sections] (dotted names nest with nested=true), = or : separators, ; and # comments incl. inline, quoted values, key[] arrays, indented continuation lines, bare keys, duplicate-key warnings. Properties: ! and # comments, backslash line continuation, escaped separators and spaces, unicode escapes. types=true (default) converts numbers, booleans (true/yes/on) and null; format= auto-detected or ini|properties. json= converts a JSON object back to INI (nested objects become [a.b] sections) or to .properties with format=properties. Params: text= or url= or json=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_ini_json
